requirement_summary: Receiver shall recover NID2 from PSS and NID1/physical-cell-ID from SSS candidates, not from configured transmit metadata.
PBCH recovery shall use the blindly recovered physical-cell-ID for PBCH DM-RS/channel estimation/decode.
Production receiver shall not consume configured PCI/NID1/NID2 as receiver input; tx metadata is allowed only for post-run scoring.
PSS/NID2 correlation shall search the complete received SSB observation window rather than a short no-signal prefix.
